meta.name: LILLY Screen Specifications
meta.description: Machine-readable screen/page definitions for LILLY. Each screen describes its route, layout, components used, data requirements, and user interactions. Maps to SvelteKit file-based routes.
meta.path_convention: All file paths are relative to the frontend/ package root (e.g. src/routes/ means frontend/src/routes/ in the monorepo).
meta.i18n_note: User-facing strings (labels, titles shown in the UI, empty state messages) are German (de-DE) placeholder examples — replace them with Paraglide.js i18n keys in implementation. Screen-level 'description' fields and section 'description' fields are developer documentation (English) and are not shown to users.
meta.section_schema: Each section uses 'component' (string|null) for the primary component. If a section composes multiple components, 'includes' (string[]) lists all contained components. 'repeat' is always an object: { kind: 'fixed', count: N } for a known number of instances, or { kind: 'dynamic', per: '<entity>' } for data-driven repetition.

dashboard.title: Übersicht
dashboard.description: Main landing page after login. Shows collection overview, recent activity, and trade suggestions at a glance.

layout.desktop: Two-column layout: stats + recent activity (left), trade matches + quick actions (right)

sections.content: Greeting with user display name and date. 'Willkommen zurück, {name}!'

sections.layout: Horizontal scroll on mobile, 4-column grid on desktop

sections.description: One progress bar per series the user collects. Ordered by completion percentage descending.
Top 3 trade matches based on matching algorithm. 'Tausch-Vorschläge' header with 'Alle anzeigen' link.
Timeline of recent actions: issues added, trades completed, messages received. Max 10 items.

collection.title: Meine Sammlung
collection.description: Full collection view with filtering, sorting, and the primary cover grid. This is where collectors spend most of their time.

sections.description: Series selector, status chips, condition range, sort, inline search

interactions.tap_card: Opens IssueDetailSheet for the tapped issue
interactions.long_press: Enters multi-select mode for batch operations (mobile)

fab.label: Hefte hinzufügen
fab.style: Brand primary filled button with glow shadow

collection_add.title: Serienraster
collection_add.description: Select a series, inspect all four collection states, and open issue details to add or edit entries deliberately.

sections.description: Large card buttons for each available series with cover art, name, and issue count. Cards use glassmorphism.
After selecting a series: grid of all issue numbers. Color and text/pattern distinguish owned, duplicate, wanted, and missing. Selecting a cell opens the detail sheet.

visual.cell_style: Rounded square with issue number centered. Uses collection_status colors.
visual.cell_animation: Spring scale and focus animation when selected

interactions.tap: Opens IssueDetailSheet for creating or editing the collection entry.
interactions.keyboard: Tab focuses a cell; Enter or Space opens IssueDetailSheet.
interactions.status_update: Saving or deleting updates the affected cell without reloading the grid.

series_detail.title: Seriendetail
series_detail.description: Public series overview page. Shows all issues of a series with the user's collection status overlaid (if logged in).

sections.description: Hero section with series name, publisher, genre, status badge (laufend/abgeschlossen), total issues count. Background: blurred random cover from the series.
sections.style: Full-width, glassmorphism overlay on blurred background image, 200px height

sections.description: User's personal progress for this series. Only shown when logged in.
All issues in the series. If user is logged in, overlays show owned/wanted/duplicate status.

issue_detail.title: Heftdetail
issue_detail.description: Full-page issue detail view. Alternative to IssueDetailSheet for direct linking and SEO.

sections.description: Large cover image (left on desktop, top on mobile), issue metadata (number, title, author, date, cycle), series breadcrumb link
Status toggle, condition selector, notes, photos. Glass card container.
Shows how many collectors have this as duplicate (supply) and how many are seeking it (demand). Link to trade matching.
sections.style: Two StatsCards side by side: 'Verfügbar zum Tausch: N' and 'Gesucht von: N'

sections.description: Community comments and ratings. Star rating display + comment list + add comment form.
External link to the source wiki article. 'Mehr im Maddraxikon →' button.

trades.title: Tausch
trades.description: Private trade hub for reciprocal matches and proposed or accepted trades. Separate links lead to the offer and wanted-list management pages.

empty_state.title: Noch keine Tauschvorschläge
empty_state.description: A match appears as soon as two collectors have complementary duplicate and wanted entries.

interactions.select_items: Selects one or more currently matching entries in both directions.
interactions.propose: POST /api/v1/me/matches/{id}/proposals, then switches to the active-trades view.

tabs.label: Aktive Tausche
tabs.description: Proposed and accepted trades of the authenticated user.

trade_offers.title: Tauschbare Hefte
trade_offers.description: Private projection of collection entries with duplicate status.

interactions.deactivate: PATCH /api/v1/me/collection/{entry_id} changes the entry to owned.

trade_wanted.title: Wunschliste
trade_wanted.description: Private projection of collection entries with wanted status.

interactions.remove: DELETE /api/v1/me/wanted/{entry_id} removes only the authenticated user's entry.

wanted_add.title: Wünsche hinzufügen
wanted_add.description: Series-scoped, searchable bulk selection of issues the user does not own.

sections.description: Required active-series selector and optional title/author search. Changing either reloads the first candidate page.
Paginated candidates exclude owned and duplicate issues. Existing wishes stay visible, checked and disabled.

interactions.select_page: Selects or clears every available issue on the visible page.
interactions.add_selected: POST /api/v1/me/wanted/bulk and announce created, unchanged and rejected counts.

trade_detail.title: Tausch-Details
trade_detail.description: Detail view of a proposed, accepted, cancelled, or completed trade snapshot with its integrated message thread.

sections.description: Status badge, privacy-safe partner display name, and proposal timestamp.
Two-column view: 'Du bietest' and 'Du erhältst'. Each column shows CoverCards with condition badges.
sections.layout: Side-by-side on desktop, stacked on mobile with clear visual separator

sections.description: Action buttons based on current status and user role (initiator vs responder)
Inline message thread linked to this trade. For discussing shipping details etc.

messages.title: Nachrichten
messages.description: Message inbox. Shows one conversation summary per trade and opens the selected thread on its own route.

layout.all_viewports: Responsive thread list. Selecting a row navigates to /messages/[id].

thread_list_item.style: Glassmorphism card, highlight on hover, brand primary left border when unread

explore.title: Entdecken
explore.description: Public discovery page. Browse available series, view community stats, and find other collectors.

sections.description: Horizontal scroll of series cards with cover art collage, name, genre badge, and issue count. Tap to navigate to series detail.
sections.style: Large cards (280px wide) with glassmorphism, cover art as blurred background

sections.description: Aggregated platform statistics. Three cards in a row.
Leaderboard-style list of most active public collectors. Avatar, name, total issues, completion percentage.
Grid of most-wanted issues across the platform. Shows cover + number of seekers.

profile.title: Mein Profil
profile.description: User profile page with independent profile and collection visibility settings.

sections.description: Avatar (editable), display name, member since, location. Edit button for own profile. Glassmorphism hero card.
sections.visual: Large avatar (96px) with edit overlay on hover. Brand primary gradient accent stripe at top.

sections.description: Physical issue total and distinct collection progress for each series. Public statistics require both profile_public and collection_public.

tabs.label: Tauschbar
tabs.description: Public list of duplicate items available for trade

sections.description: Tabbed view of public trade/want lists. Each tab shows a CoverGrid. Shareable via direct link.
Profile settings section (only on own profile). Glass card container.

fields.name: collection_public
fields.label: Sammlung öffentlich
fields.warning: Public collections also expose personal issue notes.

public_profile.title: Sammler-Profil
public_profile.description: Public view of a collector's profile when profile_public is true. Collection statistics appear only when collection_public is independently true. A private profile uses the same 404-style state as an absent profile.

public_collection.title: Öffentliche Sammlung
public_collection.description: Direct public collection view, independently available when collection_public is true even if the profile is private. Shows status, Z0–Z4 condition and escaped personal notes with preserved line breaks. Private and absent collections share the same 404-style state.

auth_login.title: Anmelden
auth_login.description: Login page with email/password form and OAuth buttons. Centered card layout.

visual.layout: Centered glassmorphism card (max 420px) on gradient background with subtle LILLY branding
visual.background: Subtle animated gradient mesh (brand primary + accent, very slow movement)

elements: OAuth buttons: Google, GitHub (outlined style with provider icons)

auth_register.title: Registrieren
auth_register.description: Registration page. Same centered card layout as login.
elements: DSGVO consent checkbox with link to privacy policy

series_overview.title: Serien
series_overview.description: Public overview of all active series. Shows series cards with cover, name, genre, issue count.

sections.description: Responsive grid of series cards. Each card shows the cover of issue #1, series name, genre badge, total issue count, and status badge (laufend/abgeschlossen).

admin_series.title: Serien-Verwaltung
admin_series.description: Admin page to manage all series including inactive ones. Admins can activate/deactivate series after reviewing imported data.

sections.description: Table of all series (including inactive). Columns: Name, Status (running/completed/cancelled), Active badge (yes/no), and issue count. Active rows can be deactivated; inactive rows link to the latest import review or to import creation when no reviewable job exists.

interactions.review_inactive_series: Navigates to /admin/import/{latest_import_job_id}; if no import job exists, navigates to /admin/import.

admin_import.title: Datenimport
admin_import.description: Admin page to start new imports and view import history. Admins select an available adapter and trigger the import.

sections.description: Dropdown/select for choosing an available import adapter (fetched from GET /api/v1/admin/adapters, shows name + version). Button 'Import starten' to trigger POST /api/v1/admin/import.

Table of all past and current import jobs. Columns: Date, Adapter, Status badge (pending/running/completed/failed), Duration, Imported issues count, Started by (admin name). Click row navigates to /admin/import/{id}.

admin_import_detail.title: Import-Details
admin_import_detail.description: Detailed view of a single import job. Shows progress during import, and a review/verification interface after completion.

sections.description: Status badge, progress bar ('243 / 620 Hefte importiert'), duration, error message (if failed). Auto-polls every 3 seconds while status is 'running'.
After completion: job-specific outcome and risk counts, pinned reference checks, blocker reasons, and warning acknowledgement. Eligible inactive series can be published from this reviewed import.

interactions.activate_reviewed_import: POST /api/v1/admin/import/{id}/activate with explicit warning acknowledgement when required

sections.description: Paginated job-specific review list with issue number, outcome, severity, metadata snapshot, cover result, and source link. Supports search plus outcome, severity, cover, and pinned-sample filters.
